Lina (Partnerships): Hey team — putting together a set of canonical Slack signal templates and action buttons for partner SEV flows (marketplace + HW + SI). Goal: 1-click actions for partners + clear who gets paged. Sharing a draft, please quick feedback. :pray:

Raj (Partner Eng): Nice. Can we include a permission check so only partner liaisons can hit the escalate button?

Maya (Support Lead): Absolutely — we should also include a short triage modal before escalate so we capture customer, impact, and whether it's already on a partner bridge. Keeps oncall context clean.

Tom (Oncall): Keep the actions minimal. Too many buttons = accidental hits. Prefer: Start War Room, Escalate Oncall, Mark Customer Informed.

Kai (Product): Also need a separate button for "Joint Announcement Hold" that sets a tag so marketing is aware when a partner-visible incident is paused for announcement prep.

Lina (Partnerships): Agreed on minimal actions. Draft block kit (very small) below — intended to post in the shared partner channel when a partner requests triage. Use as a template for automation.

Lina (Partnerships): ```json
{
  "text": "Partner SEV: Quick actions",
  "blocks": [
    {"type":"section","text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*Partner:* ACME Cloud \n*Impact:* auth timeouts for inference"}},
    {"type":"actions","elements":[
      {"type":"button","text":{"type":"plain_text","text":"Start War Room"},"action_id":"start_warroom","style":"primary"},
      {"type":"button","text":{"type":"plain_text","text":"Escalate Oncall"},"action_id":"escalate_oncall","confirm":{"title":{"type":"plain_text","text":"Confirm escalate"},"text":{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"This will page oncall and create a bridge."},"confirm":{"type":"plain_text","text":"Yes"},"deny":{"type":"plain_text","text":"No"}}},
      {"type":"button","text":{"type":"plain_text","text":"Mark Customer Informed"},"action_id":"cust_informed"}
    ]}
  ]
}
```

Raj (Partner Eng): This looks good. Two asks: 1) action payload should include partner_id and partner_tier so routing rules can pick dedicated vs hosted fallback. 2) add a small note that the button emits an audit event to the partner workspace.

Maya (Support Lead): +1 for audit events. For the triage modal, suggested fields: customer name, cluster/region, brief impact, steps tried, partner contact.

Tom (Oncall): For the escalate action, please wire it to require a quick reason in the confirmation modal — otherwise oncall gets noise.

Lina (Partnerships): Will update. Question: can the Start War Room button auto-create both the bridge and post a short DM to the partner liaison with join link? That would speed handoffs.

ops-bot: Note: automation-perms-check passed for channel #partners-acme. Escalation button restricted to role: partner-liaison, group id: GLIAISON-42.

Raj (Partner Eng): Yes — we can have the action call an internal endpoint that creates the bridge, tags partner, and returns a join link. I'll add partner_id in the payload.

Kai (Product): We should version the template. Add a small metadata comment so older integrations know when a new button was added. Eg: `template_version: "psev_v1.2"`.

Lina (Partnerships): Updated snippet pushed to the repo and the new template_version set. I'll follow up with a short walkthrough doc for partners and a one-pager for SIs.

Maya (Support Lead): Could we also include a fallback reaction pattern for partners who can't use buttons (SIs with restricted slack)? Maybe `:red_circle:` to indicate SEV, and a small slash command fallback `/partner-sev`.

Tom (Oncall): Slash fallback makes sense. Make sure `/partner-sev` requires the same minimal triage fields.

Lina (Partnerships): Final action items: 1) Raj to add partner_id & tier to payload + return join link (owner: Raj). 2) Tom/Maya to define minimal triage modal fields & confirm escalation confirmation text (owners: Tom, Maya). 3) Kai to add template_version metadata and the announcement hold button behavior (owner: Kai). 4) Lina to publish templates + short partner-facing doc and schedule a 20-min sync.

Raj (Partner Eng): I'll open the PR today.

Tom (Oncall): I'll draft the confirmation copy.

Maya (Support Lead): I'll create the triage modal spec here tomorrow.

Lina (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — scheduling sync for tomorrow 10:30 PST. :calendar:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — meeting created: "Partner SEV signal templates" 2024-10-09 10:30 PST. Join link: https://meet.redwood.example/abc123

Lina (Partnerships): Great, see you then. :raised_hands:
